Date: "Look At Us, We're In Love" was an unreleased, house-and-techno-inspired Frank Ocean project. Rather than a traditional album, it was designed as a series of singles for listeners to playlist, with several tracks dropping between 2019 and 2020. The project was shelved in 2020 due to the pandemic (which canceled his tour) and the tragic death of his brother, Ryan Breaux. However, recent promotional posters hint that Ocean is interested in making albums again.
